entitlement.keyring_unavailable: Dawnlist ma furi karin kaydka xogaha xisaabaadka (credential store) ee kombiyuutarkan (Credential Manager marka Windows la isticmaalo, Keychain marka Mac la isticmaalo), kaas oo ku haya furahaaga shatiga, oo nuqulkan dhawaan lama xaqiijin. Fur ama dib u bilow kaydka xogaha xisaabaadka oo mar kale isku day — waxba lama joojin.
entitlement.licence_inactive: Furaha shatigan waa mid dhab ah laakiin mar dambe ma shaqeynayo — rukhsadda (subscription) ayaa dhacday, la joojiyay ama lacagta dib loo celiyay. Cusboonaysii rukhsadda, kadibna mar kale isku day; haddii aad rumaysan tahay inay wali shaqeyneyso, u qor Apps@spencerfields.com. Guddigaaga iyo warqaddaada shaqo si kastaba way furan yihiin.
entitlement.mac_lapsed: App Store-ku wuxuu sheegayaa in rukhsadda (subscription) Dawnlist aanay firfircoon ahayn — waxay dhici kartaa inay dhacday, la joojiyay ama lacagta dib loo celiyay. Ku cusboonaysii App Store-ka, kadibna riix Soo Celi Iibka ee Dejinta (Settings). Guddigaaga, warqaddaada shaqo iyo wax kasta oo hore ugu jiray Mac-kan way sii furan yihiin.
entitlement.mac_not_subscribed: Wali lama xaqiijin rukhsad App Store ah oo Mac-kan ku jira, sidaa darteed ma jiro feed shaqooyin oo la akhriyi karo. Ku biir Dejinta (Settings), ama riix Soo Celi Iibka halkaas haddii aad hore u iska qortay. Guddigaaga, warqaddaada shaqo iyo wax kasta oo hore ugu jiray Mac-kan way sii furan yihiin.
entitlement.mac_unreachable: Lama gaadhi karin adeegga rukhsadda si loo xaqiijiyo rukhsaddaada App Store, mana lagu xaqiijin dhawaan. Hubi xiriirkaaga internetka oo mar kale isku day — waxba lama joojin.
entitlement.no_variant: Nuqulkan Dawnlist waxaa loo soo diyaariyay isagoo aan lahayn calaamad daabacaad sax ah ({variant}), sidaas darteed lama garan karo dukaanka uu ka yimid, mana samayn doono raadinta maalinlaha ah. Ka soo rakib mar kale meesha aad ka heshay. Boorka shaqooyinkaaga iyo baaqdaadu way sii furan yihiin si kastaba ha ahaatee.
families.armed_now: {name} waa firfircoon. Shaqooyinka la mid ah ee halkaas si toos ah ayaa loo eryi doonaa.
families.body: Marka aad diiddo laba shaqo oo isku nuuc ah oo ka socda hal shaqo-bixiye, Dawnlist wuxuu ku soo jeedinayaa xeer: joojiso howshaas shaqo-bixiyahaas, laakiin sii akhri kuwa kale. Wax lama firfircooneeyo ilaa aad taas u ogolaato, oo soo jeedin kastaaba wuxuu tusayaa diidmooyinka uu ka dhashay.

onboarding.calibration_body: Halkan waxaa ku yaal toban dhambaal oo shaqo oo firfircoon, iyo waxa Dawnlist ka fahmay mid kasta. Saxid wax kasta oo uu qaldamay. Meesha aad ku khilaafsan tahay, u sheeg jumlada saxda ah ee sax lahayd — jumladaas ayaa geli doonta baaqaaga, si khaladkaas isku mid ahi aanu dib ugu dhicin hawlgalka xiga.
onboarding.calibration_failed: Dawnlist kuma heli karin shaqooyin soo dhigan si loo isbarbardhigo: {reason} Waad dhammaystiri kartaa hagaajinta; isbarbardhigga wuxuu dhici doonaa subax uu raad-raaca akhrin karo.
onboarding.calibration_fetching: Waxaa la soo qaadayaa shaqooyin soo dhigan hadda socda oo lagu akhrinayo sharraxaaddaada. Tani waxay qaadataa hal daqiiqad ama wax ka badan.
onboarding.calibration_no_feed: Dawnlist weli ma haysto raad-raac shaqooyin uu akhriyo, sababtoo ah ma jiro diiwaan-gelin ama koodh gelitaan oo ku yaal kombiyuutarkan. Waad dhammaystiri kartaa hagaajinta; isbarbardhigga wuxuu dhici doonaa marka aad hesho mid.
onboarding.calibration_pending: Dawnlist weli lama isbarbardhigin, sidaa darteed go’aannadan waxay ku tiirsan yihiin sharraxaaddaada oo keliya, marnaba lagama hubin xukunkaaga. Isbarbardhigga wuxuu qaadaa dhawr daqiiqo: Dawnlist wuxuu ku tusayaa toban shaqo oo soo dhigan hadda socda, adiguna waad saxdaa waxa uu qaldamay, sharraxaaddaaduna waxay wax ka barataa farqiga.
onboarding.calibration_skipped: Ma jirin dhambaalo shaqo oo firfircoon oo ku filan si loo cabbiro, sidaas darteed tallaabadan waa la boodsaday — wax aad samaysay ma aha. Dawnlist ayaa mar kale ku soo bandhigi doona tallaabadan markaad mar xiga furto barnaamijka, marka raadin la shido feedhkuna la gaari karo. Waad dhammaystiri kartaa isuqajinta.

onboarding.ingest_guidance:
Ku soo rid nooc kasta oo CV-gaaga ah oo aad wali haysato — oo ay ku jiraan kuwii hore, kuwii loogu talagalay shaqo gaar ah, iyo kuwii aad u malaynayso inay duugoobeen.

Marka hore ha hagaajin. Noocyada kala duwan waxay ku sharraxaan hal door erayo kala duwan, farqigaasna waa caddaynta. Hal CV oo la hagaajiyay oo keliya waa waxa ugu qiimo yar ee aad tallaabadan siin karto.

Haddii CV-gaagu ka bilaabmo bar-tallaabo mustaqbalkaaga shaqo, sheeg. Doorarka hore waxaa badanaa laga saaraa CV-yada heerka sare, baaritaanka waana loo baahan yahay: waa waxa u sheega shaqooyinka hawlgalka ee aad dhab ahaan qabatay, halkii ay ka noqon lahaayeen kuwa aad kaliya maamushay.
onboarding.interview_body: Dawnlist wuxuu akhriyay CV-yadaada wuxuuna qabyo-qoray laba dukumeenti. Saxid — waa bilow, ma aha go'aan kama dambays ah. Xaqiiq-sheetka bidix ee ku yaal ayaa ah waxa kaliya ee gaadhsiintaadu ku ogolaato inay kaaga sheegto. Baaqa midig ku yaal ayaa go'aamiya waxa ka soo muuqda hawlgalka maalin kasta.
onboarding.low_signal: Waxaad ku raacday wax kasta, taasoo caadi ahaan macnaheedu yahay tijaabadan inay fudud tahay, ee maaha in warqadda gaabani dhammaystiran tahay.

Waad bedeli kartaa wakhti kasta gudaha Settings.

rules.body: Ka hor inta aan wax lagu akhrin qaab-nooleeye, Dawnlist wuxuu ku kalifayaa shuruudahan. Shaqo halkan lagu joojiyo wax kama qaadato; shaqo soo gudubta waxay qaadataa qayb yar oo sentigii ah inta la akhriyo. Ku bilow iyada oo aan la lahayn — ku dar shuruud markaad ogaato inaad isla go'aan mar labaad qaadanayso.
rules.conflict: Lama darin — waxay noqon lahayd mid qariya jagada aad raacday:
rules.contextual: Akhri haddii uu ku jiro cinwaanka
rules.contextual_help: Ereyo cinwaan shaqo ku macno leh laakiin faqrad faa'iidooyinka ku macno la'aan. Waxaa lagu barbardhigayaa cinwaanka iyo shirkadda oo keliya.
rules.employers_help: La kasbaday, lama qorin. Raacida jago waxay ku darsaa shaqo-bixiyahan halkan, oo shaqo kasta oo dambe oo ka timaada ayaa la akhriyaa. Haddii go'aanka la beddelo, mar kale wuu ka bixi.
rules.heading: Shuruudaha kaliyaha
rules.strong_help: Calaamad meel kasta — cinwaanka, shirkadda ama sharraxaadda. Shaqo la mid ah mid ka mid ah kuwan waxaa mar walba loo diraa in la qiimeeyo.
rules.unsupported_help: Ereyo cinwaan ah oo ka reeba shaqo si kastoo shaqo-bixiyuhu wanaagsan yahay. Waxaa la hubiyaa marka hore, iyo iyadoo lagu barbardhigayo dhammaan jagooyinka aad raacday ka hor inta aan la aqbalin.

schedule.body: Dawnlist wuxuu raadiyaa hal jeer maalintii, waqtiga hoos ku qoran, intuu ka shaqeynayo kombuyuutarkan. Haddii waqtigaas dhaafo isagoo Dawnlist xiran, wuxuu ku siin doonaa Hadda hawlgeli marka aad mar xiga furto, halkii uu wax kula kharash gelin la'aan idan ka qaadan lahaa.

schedule.sign_in_login_items: macOS wuxuu kaa codsanayaa inaad tan adigu oggolaato. Dejinta Nidaamka (System Settings) ayaa la furay: Dawnlist ku shid Login Items hoosteeda.

schedule.sign_in_policy: Qofka maamula kombuyuutarkan ayaa go'aamiyay tan, sidaas darteed halkan lagama beddeli karo.
schedule.sign_in_startup_apps: Windows wuxuu kaa codsanayaa inaad tan adigu shido. Startup apps ayaa la furay: Dawnlist ku shid halkaas.
searches.body: Kuwani waa raadimaha lagu sameeyo hawlgalka maalinlaha ee Dawnlist, kaas oo dhaca waqtiga hawlgalka ee hoos loogu dejiyay shaashaddan, intuu Dawnlist shaqeynayo. Raadin la shidayna waxay lacag kharash gasho maalin kasta oo la hawlgaliyo, sababtoo ah feedhka shaqooyinku wuxuu ku kharash gaadhsiiyaa dhambaal kasta oo soo laabma — sidaas darteed kuwa Dawnlist ku talin uu ka soo qaatay waxaad u sheegtay waxay bilaabmaan iyagoo la damiyay ilaa aad akhrido.

settings.admin_body: Bixi koodhadh gudbin (override codes), oo haddii loo baahdo iska joojiso. Koodhku wuxuu siiyaa fasax gelitaan; weligiis waxba ma iibiyo. Sheeg cidda koodh kastaa loo bixiyay — koodh aan calaamad lahayn dib looma xisaabtami karo mustaqbalka. Koodhka loogu talagalay dib-u-eegaha aplikeyshanka (app reviewer) waa inuu u oggolaadaa isticmaal dhowr jeer ah: dib-u-eegayuhu wuxuu ku tijaabin karaa mishiimo badan, ama dib u tijaabin karaa markii tijaabo lagu diido, koodh la isticmaalayna wuxuu u beddelaa dib-u-eegis fashilan.
settings.admin_confirm_revoke: Ka bixi {code}? Isla markiiba wuu joogsan doonaa, sidoo kalena dhammaan shatiyada hore looga soo saaray. Tan lama soo celin karo.
settings.admin_expires_tip: Immisa maalmood ayuu koodhku sii shaqeyn doonaa. Kaliya koodhka maamulaha qudhiisa, ama mid ku jira qorshaha mulkiilaha, ayaa loo dejin karaa inuusan waligiis dhicin.
settings.admin_issued: Waa la bixiyay {code}. Hadda koobi, halkan hal mar oo keliya ayaa lagu muujiyaa.
settings.admin_no_licence: Mishiinkan lagama helo shatibaal, sidaa darteed wax la maamulo ma jiraan.
settings.admin_pick_one: Dooro koodh aad rabto inaad joojiso.
settings.admin_revoked: {code} waa la joojiyay. Wuxuu joojin doonaa shaqeynta isku dayga xiga.
settings.admin_uses_tip: Immisa jeer koodhkani la isticmaali karo. Marnaba ha ka dhigin 1 haddii uu yahay dib-u-eege.
settings.code_redeemed: Xeerka waa la aqbalay — shatigaaga waa la kaydiyay.
settings.code_store_failed: Koodhka waa la aqbalay, laakiin Dawnlist ma kaydin karin shatiga uu ku siiyay sababtoo ah kaydka xogaha xisaabaadka ee kombiyuutarkan ma jawaabin. Furahaaga shatiga waa {key} — hadda koobiyee oo kaydso, sababtoo ah koodhku laga yaabaa inuusan mar labaad shaqeynin.
settings.data_body: Shaqooyinka lagu dhawaaqay ee Dawnlist waxaa laga leefyeeyay (laga shatiliyeyay) bixiye xogeed oo dhinac saddexaad ah. Waxaad u isticmaali kartaa raadinta shaqo ee gaarkaaga, oo ay ku jiraan kuwa aad ku darto liiskaaga la doortay. Ma laha xaq aad ku faafiso ama ku iibiso dad kale, ama aad ugu isticmaasho dhisidda adeeg shaqo oo tartan ah. Xayiraadahan waxay sii socon doonaan xitaa shaqooyinka aad haysato ka dib marka rukhsadaadu (subscription-kaagu) dhammaado.
settings.data_heading: Halka shaqooyinka lagu dhawaaqay ka yimaadaan
settings.key_body: Dawnlist wuxuu akhriyaa dhaqdhaqaaqyada shaqada oo qoraa fariimahaaga isagoo isticmaalaya moodelada Anthropic, iyadoo lagu shaqaynayo akoonkaaga gaarka ah. Samee furaha console.anthropic.com kadibna ku dhex qor halkan. Waad ka baabi'in kartaa wakhti kasta, Dawnlist-na wuxuu ku kaydiyaa maareeyaha xogta aqoonsiga ee nidaamkaaga hawlgalka — marnaba fayl kuma kaydiyo.
settings.key_forgotten: Furaha waa la saaray. Dawnlist ma shaqayn karto ilaa aad ku darto mid kale.
settings.key_none: Weli ma jiro furaha la kaydiyay — Dawnlist ma shaqayn karo iyada la'aanteed.
settings.key_store_failed: Anthropic wuu aqbalay furaha, laakiin Dawnlist ma kaydin karin sababtoo ah kaydka xogaha xisaabaadka ee kombiyuutarkan (Credential Manager marka Windows la isticmaalo, Keychain marka Mac la isticmaalo) ma jawaabin. Waxba lama kaydin. Hubi kaydka xogaha xisaabaadka, kadibna riix Kaydi (Save) oo mar kale hubi.
settings.licence_body: Ku dhex qor furaha shatiga ee ku yimid emailkaaga iibsiga. Haddii lagu siiyay xeer sokeeye (override code) halkii shati, sidaas ku dhex qor — Dawnlist ayaa ku badali doona shati.
settings.licence_inactive: Shatigan mar dambe ma shaqeynayo — rukhsaddu way dhacday, la joojiyay ama lacagta dib loo celiyay. Cusboonaysii oo Dawnlist mar kale wuu shaqayn doonaa.
settings.licence_none: Weli ma jiro shati la kaydiyay.
settings.licence_store_failed: Dawnlist ma kaydin karin furaha shatiga sababtoo ah kaydka xogaha xisaabaadka ee kombiyuutarkan (Credential Manager marka Windows la isticmaalo, Keychain marka Mac la isticmaalo) ma jawaabin. Waxba lama kaydin — hubi kaydka xogaha xisaabaadka, kadibna mar kale riix Kaydi.
settings.licence_unknown: Adeegga shatiga ma aqoonsanayo furahan. Ku hubi iimeylkaaga iibsiga.
settings.licence_unverified: Waa la kaydiyay, weli lama xaqiijin — lama gaadhi karin adeegga shatiga. Dawnlist mar kale wuu hubin doonaa ka hor socodka soo socda.
settings.licence_valid: Waa la xaqiijiyay — waa firfircoon qorshaha {plan}.
settings.offer_assigned: {code} — tan waxaad siisaa {who}. Hadda koobiiso; halkan ayaa ugu fudud in laga helo meel kasta oo kale.
settings.offer_body: Qof siin gelitaan bilaash ah oo ku saabsan rukhsadda Mac. Koodhadhka waxaa laga sameeyaa App Store Connect, waxaana lagu soo shubaa si gaar ah; tan waxay bixisaa waxa hore u jira halkan. Koodhka waxaa lagu isticmaalaa Mac-ka qofka helaya, marka adiga qudhaadu uma baahnid mid.
settings.offer_comp_done_off: Shatigooda hadda wuxuu dhammaanayaa marka Apple joojiso daboolidda. Wax kasta oo Apple horey u siiyay ayaa sii wadi doona ilaa dhammaadka.
settings.offer_comp_done_on: Shatigooda wuu sii jiri doonaa ka dib marka Apple joojiso daboolidda. Wax dheeraad ah oo ay gelin lahaayeen ma jiraan.
settings.offer_comp_not_eligible: Rukhsaddan waa mid la bixiyay, sidaas darteed lama bilaash u siin karo. Bilaash-siinta waxaa loo qaadan karaa kaliya dadka ku soo galay dalab bilaash ah.
settings.offer_comp_on: Sii wad helitaanka ka dib mudada bilaashka ah
settings.offer_confirm_void: Ma joojisaa bixinta {code}? Halkan looma siin doono qof kale. Waxay SII AHAAN DOONTAA MID LA ISTICMAALI KARO Apple, kaas oo aan haysan wax hab ah oo lagu soo celin karo koodh marka la sameeyo, sidaas darteed qof kasta oo hore u haysta ayaa weli isticmaali kara.
settings.offer_empty: Weli halkan kuma jiraan koodhad. Samee koox (batch) App Store Connect kadibna soo shub ka hor inta aadan bixin midna.
settings.offer_left: {n} ayaa u hadhay in la bixiyo
settings.offer_people_body: Kuwa isticmaalay koodh oo isticmaalaya app-ka Mac. Bilaash u siinta qofku wuxuu shatigiisa sii jirin karaa ka dib marka mudada bilaashka ah oo Apple siiyay dhammaato, taasoo micnaheedu yahay inuusan mar dambe waxba isticmaalin. Rukhsad kaliya kii ku bilaabmay dalab bilaash ah ayaa la bilaash u siin karaa; mid qof lacag ku bixiyay marnaba lama bilaash u siin karo.
settings.offer_pick_one: Marka hore dooro koodh liiska ku jira.
settings.offer_pick_person: Marka hore dooro qof liiska ku jira.
settings.offer_voided: {code} mar dambe lama bixin doono. Qof kasta oo hore u haysta ayaa weli isticmaali kara.
settings.offer_who_required: Sheeg cidda uu koodhkani u socdo. Koodh aan qof loo diiwaan gelin lama xisaabin karo mustaqbalka.
settings.report_body: Dawnlist wuxuu isticmaalaa caqli macmal (AI) si uu u qiimeeyo dalabyada shaqada uuna u qoro fariimahaaga. Haddii ay soo saarto wax aan habboonayn, wax xun, ama qalad cad ah, ka cabo, waana la akhrin doonaa.
settings.report_link: Ka Cabo Waxyaabaha AI-du Soo Saartay
settings.subscribe_body: Feedka shaqooyinka ee Dawnlist waa rukun (subscription), oo lagu iibsado App Store-ka. Wax kasta oo hore uga jira Mac-kan sidoodii bay ahaan doonaan - boordhkaaga, warbixintaada iyo raadraacaaga uma baahna rukun si loo akhriyo.
settings.subscribe_deferred: Iibkaaga wuxuu sugayaa oggolaansho — tusaale ahaan, kan qabanqaabiyaha qoyska, iyadoo la adeegsanayo Ask to Buy. Dawnlist si toos ah ayuu u qaadan doonaa marka la oggolaado, sidaa darteed uma baahnid inaad mar labaad iibsato.
settings.subscribe_done: Waad diiwaangashantahay. Feedhku wuu kuu akhriyi doonaa laga bilaabo hawlgalka maalinlaha ee xiga.
settings.subscribe_still_waiting: App Store weli ma jawaabin. Haddii aan warqad iibsi soo bixin, hubi inaad ku saxiixan tahay App Store — dhismaha tijaabada, ka eeg System Settings, App Store, Sandbox Account. Waad isku dayi kartaa mar kale, waad soo celin kartaa iibsi hore, ama waad sii wadi kartaa oo rukumaan mar dambe.
settings.subscribe_terms: {title} — {length}. Waxay si toos ah dib ugu cusboonaysiisantaa qiimo isku mid ah ilaa aad joojiso, taas oo aad ku samayn karto wakhti kasta ee System Settings.
settings.subscribe_unavailable: App Store-ku hadda iibsi kama qaadi karo Mac-kan.
settings.title: Dawnlist — dejinta
storekit.not_ready: Xiriirka App Store-ku wali wuu bilaabayaa. Wax yar ka dib isku day.
storekit.not_saved: Rukhsaddaada waa la xaqiijiyay, laakiin Keychain-ka Mac-kan ma kaydin. Dawnlist mar kale isku dayi doonaa marka xigta ee la furo — laguuma qaadi doono lacag laba jeer.
storekit.nothing_to_restore: Waxba looma soo celin karo xisaabtan.
storekit.unconfirmed: App Store-ku wuu haystaa iibka, laakiin Dawnlist weli kama xaqiijin adeegga rukhsadda. Isagu si toos ah ayuu mar kale isku dayi doonaa marka xigta ee Dawnlist la furo — laguuma qaadi doono lacag laba jeer.
tray.still_running: Dawnlist wali wuu shaqeynayaa, sidaas darteed hawlgalkaaga maalinlaha ahi wuxuu ku dhici doonaa waqtigiisa. Ka fur ama ka bax calaamaddan.
update.body: Nuqulkan wuxuu ka yimid websaydka, sidaas darteed cusboonaysiinuhuna halkaas ayay ka imanayaan. Boggga soo dejinta wuxuu leeyahay nooca cusub, oo la saxeexay, iyadoo checksum-kiisu uu ku daabacan yahay agtiisa. Wax kastaa oo ku saabsan mishiinkan ma isbedelayaan ilaa aad adigu rakibto.
update.title: Cusboonaysiin ayaa la heli karaa
voice.no_profile: Wali ma jiro qaab-cod — ku dar qaar ka mid ah iimayladaada la diray
voice.profile_from: Codka waxaa laga bartay {count} fariimood oo aad adigu dirtay
